concept: Финальный набор «Вестерн», собранный продюсером из вариантов A, B, C.

cards.label: Lasso
cards.key_features: a neat round coil of twisted rope with a medium open loop resting on top of the coil; the whole lasso is compact and roughly round overall, not stretched out
cards.pose: The coil is tilted diagonally, seen slightly from above, with the loop lying over it toward the upper right

cards.label: Stetson
cards.object: cowboy hat with a curled brim and a hatband
cards.story_detail: a small feather tucked into the hatband
cards.key_features: tall pinched crown with a dent on top, wide brim curled up at both sides, a dark brown hatband
cards.pose: The hat is tilted diagonally, seen slightly from above and from the front so the crown dent and the curled brim both read

cards.label: Hay Bale
cards.key_features: straw texture, two tight twine bands around the bale
cards.pose: We look down at the bale at about 40 degrees, the horseshoe leaning on its front side

cards.label: Barrel Race
cards.object: wooden barrel painted in bold stripes
cards.story_detail: a little pennant flag stuck on top
cards.key_features: a classic bulging barrel shape with metal hoops, bold red and white stripes
cards.pose: The barrel stands slightly turned, seen from eye level, with hoof prints in the sand around it

cards.label: Swing Doors
cards.object: pair of saloon swinging half-doors in a simple wooden door frame
cards.key_features: two short louvered half-doors hanging in the middle of the frame, open gap above and below them, one door swinging slightly open
cards.pose: Frontal 3/4 view at eye level, the right door swung slightly toward the viewer

cards.label: Saddle
cards.object: western saddle on a wooden saddle stand
cards.story_detail: a checkered saddle blanket under it
cards.key_features: a high horn at the front, a deep curved seat, stirrups hanging down at the side
cards.pose: 3/4 side view with the horn toward the upper left, camera at eye level

cards.label: Bull Ride
cards.object_color: chocolate brown with a cream muzzle
cards.scene: a sandy rodeo arena with a white wooden fence
cards.story_detail: a round padded mat under it
cards.key_features: two short curved horns, a small saddle grip on its back, a sturdy pole base; cute and not scary
cards.pose: Low camera, the bull rears up slightly with its head toward the viewer

cards.label: Lucky Sack
cards.object: plump burlap sack tied with a rope
cards.story_detail: shiny gold coins spilling out of its open top onto the floor
cards.key_features: rough woven burlap texture, a rope tie at the neck, plain gold coins with no symbols
cards.pose: The sack sits slightly tilted in 3/4 view, coins pouring toward the viewer

cards.label: Iron Horse
cards.scene: a railway curving through a green prairie
cards.story_detail: a big puffy cloud of white steam from the chimney
cards.key_features: tall funnel chimney, cow-catcher at the front, big red spoked wheels, golden bands on the boiler; no black or grey large areas
cards.pose: The locomotive comes along a curving track toward the viewer, its front big in the foreground

cards.label: Saloon
cards.scene: a plain warm golden dusty ground under a bright blue sky with a couple of soft clouds
cards.story_detail: swinging saloon doors at the entrance
cards.key_features: a tall false-front facade with a blank sign board (no letters), a few simple windows, a covered porch with posts and swinging doors; simplified shapes and few details; only the building, the ground and the sky — no neighbouring buildings, no barrels, no signs with text
cards.pose: Low-angle 3/4 view of the facade, the porch and doors closest to the camera
